test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct spelling of the incorrectly spelt word. 

Labradors are gentle, docil dogs.
solution:
The correct answer is "**docile.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options: 
 
 
• The options 1, 2 and 3 are incorrectly spelled.
 
 
 
• **The word 'docile' in option 4 is spelled correctly.**
 
 
• **It means easily trained or obedient.**
 
• Example: She is a black, gentle and docile dog.
 
 
 
• The correct spelling of the word is 'docile' with one 'o' and one 'e'.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In options 1, 2 and 3 the correct spellings should be:
 
 
• "Labradors" which means a breed of dogs.
 
• "Gentle" means not so violent or extreme.
